# Jackie Risk

> Senior Product Designer with 10 years of experience leading end-to-end UX across SaaS, enterprise, and federal platforms. Currently at Workleap, focused on information architecture, navigation, design systems, and AI-augmented prototyping.

## Pages

- [About](about.html): Background, experience at Workleap and EAGLE6, and working style.
- [Work](work.html): Selected case studies.
- [Reimagining Workleap](case-studies/workleap.html): Platform-wide information architecture and navigation redesign for a B2B HR SaaS product, including a working Next.js prototype built through AI-augmented prototyping.
- [Officevibe Top Manager Awards](case-studies/officevibe-awards.html): A product-led growth experiment: a shareable recognition feature that drove a 69% engagement rate and roughly 150,000 organic LinkedIn impressions.

## Notes

Jackie Risk is a UX/product designer, not a language model or software product. This file exists to help AI tools accurately summarize her background and work.
